subject: Mido
text: Speaking to Mido near the entrance of Kokiri Forest causes him to blame Link for the Deku Tree's death and leave.

evidence.quote: Mido is once again blocking your path, so speak to him.  Mido will blame you for the Deku Tree's death, the take off, presumably to sulk somewhere.

subject: Kokiri Forest
text: Crossing the lake and heading to the western edge of Kokiri Forest allows Link to exit through a hollowed log.

evidence.quote: Jump across the lake and follow the path to the western edge of Kokiri Forest.  The Kokiri who originally blocked your path here is now gone, so you can exit through the hollowed log.  Go through to leave the Kokiri Forest.

subject: Saria
text: Saria gives Link the Fairy Ocarina as a parting gift on the bridge leading to Hyrule Field.

evidence.quote: As you pass over the bridge leading to Hyrule Field, you will come across Saria.  She accepts that Link is leaving, and gives him the Fairy Ocarina as a parting gift.

subject: Kaepora Gaebora
text: Kaepora Gaebora stops Link upon entering Hyrule Field to explain how to get to Hyrule Castle and how the map works.

evidence.quote: Take a few steps forward, and simultaneously the best and most annoying character in the game will stop you: Kaepora Gaebora.  He'll explain how to get to Hyrule Castle, and also how your map works.

subject: Hyrule Castle Gates
text: Rolling continually along the road to Hyrule Castle ensures Link reaches it before night falls and the gates close.

evidence.quote: Follow the road to it's end to reach Hyrule Castle.  Make sure you roll all the way (by continually pressing the A button as you run), otherwise it will be night time by the time you reach Hyrule Castle, and the gates will be closed.

subject: Crate
text: Rolling into the crates in the rear of the Gatehouse reveals a Gold Skulltula that yields a token.

evidence.quote: Smash all of the pots in this room with your sword, then destroy the crates in the rear of the room by rolling into them.  One of them contains a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it, and take the token it leaves behind.

subject: Malon
text: Malon is found near the opposite side of the fountain in the Hyrule Castle Market.

evidence.quote: Head around to the opposite side of the fountain, and speak with the little girl in the white dress.  This is Malon, another important bit character.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: To win the Big Bullet Bag in the Shooting Gallery, you must shoot every rupee that appears without missing any.

evidence.quote: To win the Big Bullet Bag, you have to shoot every rupee that appears without missing a single one.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: In the initial Shooting Gallery round, rupees appear in a preset sequence: in the middle; from the left, then from the right; jumping from the middle; from left and right simultaneously; two from the right going left; and two from the left going right.

evidence.quote:
For this first run through the Shooting Gallery, the rupees appear in a preset order.  The order is:

1.)  In the middle
2.)  From the left, then from the right
3.)  Jumps from the middle
4.)  From the left AND right
5.)  Two rupees coming from the right, going left
6.)  Two rupees coming from the left, going right

subject: Shooting Gallery Clerk
text: Successfully shooting all targets in the Shooting Gallery rewards the Bullet Bag x40, increasing Slingshot capacity by 10.

evidence.quote: Keep playing the minigame until you successfully shoot all of the targets, and the clerk will award you with the Bullet Bag x40, which increases the ammo capacity of your Slingshot by 10.

subject: Hyrule Castle Gatehouse Pots
text: If you run out of rupees for the Shooting Gallery, smash the pots in the Gatehouse to replenish supplies.

evidence.quote: If you run out of rupees trying to complete the game, then return to the Hyrule Castle Gatehouse and smash the pots to replenish your supplies.

subject: Tree
text: Rolling into Kaepora Gaebora's tree in the Hyrule Castle Garden after he flies away reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Listen to his rant about guards, then when he flies away roll into his tree to make a Gold Skulltula appear.

subject: White Dog
text: At night, a small white dog behind the stall to the left of the Market entrance from the Drawbridge will follow Link.

evidence.quote: Run behind the little stall to the left, and you should coax a small white dog into following you.

subject: Little Richard's Owner
text: Returning the lost dog Little Richard to the lady in the second house on the left in the Back Alley rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Speak with the big fat lady in this house, and she will recognize the lost dog as her own.  She'll reward you with a Piece of Heart for finding Little Richard (good golly, miss molly!).

subject: Malon
text: Malon stands near a vine on the wall in the Garden and gives Link an egg to hatch into a chicken to wake her father Talon.

evidence.quote: Malon should now be standing near a long vine on the wall to your right....Malon also gives you an Egg, for no apparent reason.  You'll need the Chicken inside the egg to wake Talon, however, so accept it with gratitude.

subject: Ivy Wall
text: Climbing the ivy wall and dropping down on the other side of the marble arch sneaks Link past the first two guards.

evidence.quote: Climb up the ivy wall to the top (it has some rough spots where if you don't climb up in just the right place, you'll fall off).  At the top, run forward a bit, past the gossip stone, to the top of the large marble arch.  Drop down to the ground on the other side of the arch, where you will land on the other side of the gate which formerly blocked your path.

subject: Garden Hill Path
text: Run up the hill at the third graphical break near its center toward the flowers at the top, then proceed forward and slightly left to find and climb a brick wall.

evidence.quote: The place you need to run up is the third break in the hill, approximately near it's center.  Go straight up the hill, and at the top there is a cluster of flowers.  Run straight at these flowers, then begin running forward and slightly to the left until you reach a wall.  Part of the wall is tiled with some bricks; climb up these bricks.

subject: Castle Moat
text: Jumping off the cliff past the gossip stone into the moat and swimming to its left end leads to a dirt patch and a stone platform where Talon is sleeping.

evidence.quote: Jump straight off the cliff, and go right into the moat.  Swim down to the end of the moat until it breaks left, then climb up onto the small patch of dirt, and from there climb up to the stone platform.  Run to the left from the stone platform, where you will find Talon fast asleep.

subject: Talon
text: Using the hatched Chicken near Talon wakes him up, causing him to run off and clear the path.

evidence.quote: Stand near Talon so that Navi flutters near him, then use the Chicken to wake him up.  Speak with Talon, and he will suddenly remember that he left Malon behind.  He'll run off, clearing the path for you to push the milk crates near Talon into position so that you can sneak in through the castle moat.

subject: Drainage Pipe
text: Pushing the milk crates into Talon's vacated spot lets Link jump to the drainage pipe, which must be entered during the daytime.

evidence.quote: Push both of the milk crates through the gap which was recently vacated by Talon.  You can then climb onto the crates, and then jump over to the draining pipe which feeds the moat.  If it's nighttime, then loiter around until it becomes daytime.  You won't be able to sneak through the next area at night, as the guard is increased at night.  Once it's daytime, climb through the drainage pipe to enter the next area.
